description: This source file implements the TTSURLConstructer class, which constructs URLs for Text-to-Speech services, including handling HTTP GET and POST requests, string sanitization, and punctuation processing.

classes.name: TTSURLConstructer
classes.description: A class responsible for constructing URLs for TTS services, handling both remote and local endpoints, sanitizing input strings, and managing HTTP interactions.

methods.name: constructURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL based on configuration, text, and context (fallback/local).

methods.name: httpgetURL
methods.description: Builds an HTTP GET request URL with parameters for TTS service.

methods.name: httppostURL
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to obtain a TTS URL, handling curl setup and response parsing.

methods.name: replaceIfIsolated
methods.description: Replaces occurrences of a substring only if isolated by punctuation or whitespace.

methods.name: isSilentPunctuation
methods.description: Checks if a character is considered silent punctuation.

methods.name: replaceSuccesivePunctuation
methods.description: Removes successive silent punctuation and whitespace from a string.

methods.name: curlSanitize
methods.description: Uses curl to URL-encode a string.

methods.name: sanitizeString
methods.description: Sanitizes input string by replacing certain substrings and punctuations, then URL-encoding.
